arStrings.szText: The demon Ae'grom can be found somewhere in the Brackish Pans. I will find this fiend and bind it to my will.
Search for the demon Ae'grom in the Brackish Pans
While searching for the demon Ae'grom in the Brackish Pans, I discovered a pentagram overseen by Hattar's goat familiar, Valloch. Perhaps the beast and this ritual can help me find the demon I seek.
With the help of Hattar's goat familiar, I have summoned a massive Hellwyrm from the earth. I think the demon may live within the creature's entrails. Only one way to find out.
